detail: Weighted aggregation via aggregateChecks helper gives MUST/MUST_NOT checks veto power (score 0) while SHOULD checks degrade gracefully (0.5). Threshold of 0.8 means a scenario can fail one SHOULD check and still pass, but any MUST failure is an automatic fail. Rule IDs trace to BEHAVIORS.md for auditability.
summary: Scorers use weighted severity aggregation: MUST fail=0, SHOULD fail=0.5, pass=1 with DEFAULT_THRESHOLD=0.8
